title: Resume cancels a pending session Delete in memory without stamping the row, so a host restart restores the Delete and blocks dispatch again
outcome: Cancelling a pending observation Delete through Resume is persisted (row stamped and committed) and published, so it survives a host restart and the UI matches memory.
acceptance: One helper used by all three sites (session_lifecycle.rs resume path ~544-550, cancel_observation_delete_for_resume ~1599-1611, human_queue_choices.rs:133) clears observation_delete_requested, restores the preview, stamps the session row and commits it, rolling back on a commit error.

A regression test: a Delete retained with SOURCE_OBSERVATION_ACTIVE_DELETE_RETAINED, then Resume (including a Resume that then returns 409 busy), then reload from SQLite, shows observation_delete_requested=false and dispatch not blocked.

completion.summary: Resume now cancels a retained observation Delete through one stamping, committing, publishing helper, with rollback on persistence failure. Regression tests cover public/local busy Resume and durable reload. Landed eb78d349; independent evaluation92822ea1 passed both criteria.
